text: Understanding Git branching is an important skill for anyone working with version control. A branch lets you work on new ideas without affecting the main code. Developers often create feature branches to build a single feature safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Teams also use pull requests to review changes before merging, which helps catch mistakes early. This workflow keeps the project organised and allows several people to work at the same time. By using branches, merging, and pull requests, developers can collaborate smoothly and keep their code stable.
